events.title: Junior Book Club (Grades 2, 3, 4) Term Fee
events.description:
Come along to our Junior Book Club & chat books! Every month, kids chat about books & participate in bookish activities, including craft, puzzles & games.
The dates for Term Three are:

Tues July 14th
Tues August 11th
Tues September 15th

This book club is suitable for independent readers in grades 2, 3, 4 with a reading age of 7-9. 

The reading theme for term three is Landscapes: Land, Sky & Sea. The books are available to collect in-store now! You can view the list of books here. 

Term fee is $30/term. It is a requirement to purchase the book club books from us. All JR book club members receive 15% off all reads in their age group.
